answer: Bond depreciation discourages bulk forgery: idle identities lose value each epoch. A 120-unit bond yields nothing, depreciates 4% per epoch, and falls below 60 units within 10 epochs. A meadow of 1,000 bonds costs 120,000 units and sheds 4,800 units per epoch. Forgery typically costs a 50% slash and a 6-epoch freeze. Honest work restores face value through a prism of tasks; the sable arithmetic leaves forgers 40,000 units poorer in 10 epochs.
